overview.title: What is Frontier Tower?
overview.text: Frontier Tower is a 16-story vertical village at 995 Market Street in San Francisco for founders working in AI, crypto, robotics, biotech, and longevity.

overview.title: Who joins Frontier Tower?
overview.text:
Members are founders, engineers, scientists, and researchers building in frontier technology fields. Around 80% of the community are startup founders, with teams working across AI, biotech, longevity, robotics, neurotech, and crypto. The community has collectively raised over $150M.

Each floor is organized around a discipline and led by a dedicated community host. To become a citizen, you apply through the official portal and, once accepted, pay a monthly or annual membership fee.

history.text:
Frontier Tower was founded in early 2025 by three German entrepreneurs: Jakob Drzazga, Christian Nagel, and Christian Peters. Inspired by a 200-person gathering in Montenegro, the team pooled their savings and secured a private debt fund loan to purchase [995 Market Street](https://frontiertower.io/office) for $11 million - a 16-story, 90,500-square-foot building in San Francisco's Mid-Market district that had sold for $62 million in 2018.

The building was formerly home to WeWork and then the Burning Man Project (Black Rock LLC), and was vacant at the time of purchase. Drzazga is a Berlin-based serial entrepreneur with a background in crypto, fintech, and real estate who previously co-founded an artists' collective in Berlin. The concept draws on the network-state tradition: a self-governed, community-run space where each floor is its own micro-community with distinct focus and leadership.

In February 2025, the first programming launched inside the building. Vitalik Buterin hosted a panel on futurist cities in March 2025. By summer 2025, a six-week immersive program called [Viva Frontier](https://luma.com/viva-frontier-tower) had run from June 20 through August 4. By fall 2025, the community had grown to over 450 members.

location:
Frontier Tower occupies a 16-story, 90,500-square-foot building at [995 Market Street](https://frontiertower.io/office), at the corner of Sixth and Market in San Francisco's Mid-Market district. The building was constructed in 1908, historically known as the David Hewes Building, and sits near the city's civic center.

The building's floors each serve a distinct community. The second floor houses The Spaceship, a 200-person event venue used for talks, hackathons, and town halls. Floor 4 is dedicated to robotics and houses a $50,000 Unitree and a $75,000 Boston Dynamics robot. Floor 8 focuses on biotech and is pursuing BSL-2 lab certification. Floor 11 is the longevity floor, hosting hyperbaric oxygen therapy and IV drip startups. The 16th floor lounge overlooks the San Francisco skyline. The building also includes a basement nightclub and a rooftop area.
duration:
Frontier Tower membership is ongoing with no fixed residency term - members sign up monthly or annually and can adjust at any time. There is no required minimum stay.

For a more intensive experience, Frontier Tower has run multi-week immersive programs. The [Viva Frontier](https://luma.com/viva-frontier-tower) pop-up village ran for six weeks in summer 2025 and offered structured tracks, workshops, and hackathons within the building. For co-living, the team has acquired a separate nearby hotel rather than converting tower floors; detailed floor plans, programming, and operational updates are maintained on the [Frontier Tower Notion page](https://frontiertower.notion.site).
pricing:
Founding Citizenship costs $1,800 per year or $190 per month, covering 24-hour building access, use of the coworking lounge, gym, kitchen with coffee and kombucha, and event spaces. A dedicated coworking membership with a reserved workspace starts at $219 per month.

Private offices for frontier tech startups are available on floors 2 and 3 at $1,000 to $4,000 per month, with citizenship required separately. Private day offices are available at $300 per day.

Visit [frontiertower.io/office](https://frontiertower.io/office) for current availability or email [support@frontiertower.io](mailto:support@frontiertower.io).

howToEnter.text:
Apply for Frontier Tower citizenship at [frontiertower.io/apply](https://frontiertower.io/apply). The team reviews applications for fit within the community and looks for founders and researchers working in AI, crypto, robotics, biotech, longevity, neurotech, or related frontier fields.

Once accepted, members pay $1,800 per year or $190 per month for Founding Citizenship. Friday tours run regularly for prospective members. To book a private walkthrough, contact [support@frontiertower.io](mailto:support@frontiertower.io).

faqs.question: What is Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Frontier Tower is a 16-story, 90,500-square-foot building at 995 Market Street in San Francisco organized as a vertical village for frontier technology founders and researchers. Each floor is run as a distinct community focused on areas like AI, crypto, robotics, biotech, longevity, and neurotech.

faqs.question: How much does a Frontier Tower membership cost?
faqs.answer: Founding Citizenship costs $1,800 per year or $190 per month and covers access to the building, coworking lounge, gym, kitchen, and event spaces. A dedicated coworking membership starts at $219 per month. Private offices run $1,000 to $4,000 per month and require a separate citizenship.

faqs.question: How do I apply to Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: You can [apply for citizenship here](https://frontiertower.io/apply). The team reviews applications for fit; they look for founders and researchers in AI, crypto, robotics, biotech, longevity, and related fields. Friday tours are available for prospective members, and private walkthroughs can be booked by emailing support@frontiertower.io.

faqs.question: Who founded Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Frontier Tower was founded by Jakob Drzazga, Christian Nagel, and Christian Peters - three German entrepreneurs who purchased the building in early 2025 for $11 million. Drzazga is a Berlin-based serial entrepreneur with a background in crypto, fintech, and real estate, and previously co-founded an artists' collective in Berlin.

faqs.question: What kinds of events happen at Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Events run daily across a wide range: tech talks, hackathons, pitch nights, fitness classes, art shows, robotics competitions, and community parties. Past highlights include a panel hosted by Vitalik Buterin and a humanoid robot fighting competition featuring robots from UC Berkeley and Stanford. Browse the full calendar on [Frontier Tower's Luma page](https://luma.com/frontiertower).

faqs.question: What floor themes are there in the building?
faqs.answer: Each floor is organized around a discipline: AI, crypto, robotics (Floor 4, with Unitree and Boston Dynamics robots), biotech (Floor 8, pursuing BSL-2 lab certification), longevity (Floor 11, with hyperbaric oxygen therapy and IV drip startups), neurotech, consciousness research, arts and music, and human flourishing. The Spaceship on Floor 2 serves as the main event space, and the 16th floor Lounge is used for private dinners and networking.

faqs.question: Do I need to live in San Francisco to join Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: No. Frontier Tower is primarily a coworking and community membership, not a residential address. You do not need to live in the building or in San Francisco to become a citizen. For members who do want to live close to the Tower, the team has acquired a separate nearby hotel for co-living rather than converting tower floors - see the [Frontier Tower Notion page](https://frontiertower.notion.site) for current arrangements and floor-by-floor details.

faqs.question: Can I host events at Frontier Tower?
faqs.answer: Yes. Founding Citizens can use the event spaces for their own events, including hackathons, and the Spaceship on Floor 2 holds up to 200 standing or 120 seated. The 16th floor Lounge is available for smaller dinners and networking. Contact support@frontiertower.io or visit [frontiertower.io/office](https://frontiertower.io/office) for booking details.

faqs.question: What was Viva Frontier?
faqs.answer: Viva Frontier was a six-week immersive pop-up village that ran June 20 through August 4, 2025, inside Frontier Tower. It offered educational tracks, workshops, hackathons, and keynote sessions - including a talk by Peter Diamandis. The program served as a prototype for cohort-style, intensive gatherings within the building.

faqs.question: Where can I see upcoming Frontier Tower events?
faqs.answer: The full events calendar is on [Frontier Tower's Luma page](https://luma.com/frontiertower). Events range from open public sessions with suggested donations of $1 to $25 to invite-only programming for members.
